text:
```yaml
name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner-label:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "self-hosted"

jobs:
  cleanup:
    name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner-label }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Clean up workspace
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up workspace before checkout..."
          # Remove any existing build artifacts or caches that might interfere
          rm -rf .pytest_cache
          rm -rf __pycache__
          rm -rf *.pyc
          rm -rf .mypy_cache
          rm -rf .ruff_cache
          rm -rf target
          rm -rf .cargo
          
          # Ensure proper permissions for the current user
          if [ -f "scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh" ]; then
            chmod +x scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh
            ./scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh
          fi
          
          echo "Workspace cleanup completed."

      - name: Verify environment
        run: |
          echo "Verifying environment..."
          python3 --version || echo "Python3 not found, skipping Python checks"
          rustc --version || echo "Rust not found, skipping Rust checks"
          echo "Environment verification completed."
```
